claims.claim: Writing by hand rather than typing improves conceptual understanding and recall of the material written.
claims.construct: longhand vs laptop note-taking; the encoding effects of handwriting

sources.cite: Van der Weel & van der Meer (2024)

grounding.helps: when the page is worked by hand and the aim is to think it through in your own words; any advantage of handwriting over typing is small and contested, so no page rests on it
grounding.backfires: when writing by hand slows you so much that you get less down: in note-taking studies writing more went with better scores, and the direct replication of the best-known handwriting study found no advantage
